description: This file defines a repository interface for managing ApplicationCurrency entities in a Spring Data JPA context. It includes methods for retrieving currency data, caching strategies, and cache eviction upon modifications, acting as a data access layer for currency information within the application.

classes.name: ApplicationCurrencyRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for ApplicationCurrency entities, incorporating caching and query methods for currency data management.

methods.name: findOneByCode
methods.description: Retrieves an ApplicationCurrency entity by its currency code, utilizing cache for efficiency.

methods.name: findCurrencyDataByCode
methods.description: Fetches CurrencyData object with detailed currency information for the given code, utilizing cache.

methods.name: findAllSorted
methods.description: Returns a list of CurrencyData objects sorted according to the provided Sort parameter.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a single ApplicationCurrency entity and clears relevant caches.

methods.name: saveAll
methods.description: Saves multiple ApplicationCurrency entities; cache is cleared upon operation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a given ApplicationCurrency entity, invalidating caches.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Deletes all ApplicationCurrency entities and clears caches.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Deletes a collection of ApplicationCurrency entities, invalidating caches.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes an ApplicationCurrency by its ID, with cache eviction.

methods.name: deleteAllById
methods.description: Deletes multiple ApplicationCurrency entities by their IDs, clearing cache.

methods.name: saveAndFlush
methods.description: Saves an ApplicationCurrency entity and immediately flushes changes to the database, with cache clearing.
